{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Define the target population: new customers reached by paid_search
# This is the intersection of 'customer_segment == new' and 'channel == paid_search'
target_group = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Compute the conversion rate: fraction of converted customers in this group
n_total = len(target_group)
n_converted = target_group['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate = n_converted / n_total

print(f"Number of new customers reached by paid_search: {n_total}")
print(f"Number of converted customers in this group: {n_converted}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate:.4f}")"}
